caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, a horse bit, positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The bit consists of two large, oval-shaped cheekpieces, each with two horizontal bars and one diagonal bar inside, and a ring attached to the lower side of each cheekpiece. Extending horizontally between the cheekpieces are two curved shanks that meet at the center, where they are joined with a rounded, knotted connection. The metal of the bit is rendered in shades of brown and gray, giving it a worn, slightly rusty appearance. At the lower right portion of the image, there is text that reads "HAROLD E. BILLARD 1940." The background is unadorned, with some mild discoloration and minor stains at the edges, but void of any additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Jay Eye See Driving Bit
